title: Optimizing Autonomous Vehicle Navigation Through Reinforcement Learning in Dynamic Urban Environments
abstract: Autonomous vehicle (AV) navigation in dynamic urban environments faces challenges such as unpredictable traffic conditions, varying road user behaviors, and complex road networks.
